---
title: "Assignment WK07: The Census API"
date: "2026-10-06"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.align = "center")
source(here::here("R", "slide-things.R"))
```


1. Get a Census API Key: [Use your name and email address in this form.](https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html)

2. Install the [`tidycensus`](https://walker-data.com/tidycensus/) package. Read
at least about [basic usage of
tidycensus](https://walker-data.com/tidycensus/articles/basic-usage.html),though you should also look at [Spatial Data in
Tidycensus](https://walker-data.com/tidycensus/articles/spatial-data.html) and
[Margins of Error in the
ACS](https://walker-data.com/tidycensus/articles/margins-of-error.html), and
[Other Census Bureau
Datasets](https://walker-data.com/tidycensus/articles/other-datasets.html).
Additional detail can be found in @walker23:_analy_us_census_data.

3. Work through some examples of getting and graphing data from the Census in the "Basic
Usage" and "Spatial Data" sections of the tidycensus documentation. Find
something interesting about the U.S. as a whole, or about counties within a
state of your choice. Bring the results to class.
